# Beef

Beef's licence (`LICENSE.TXT`) and the licences of what its compiler, tools and runtime include
(`LICENSES.TXT`), copied from https://github.com/jayrulez/Beef (a fork of
https://github.com/beefytech/Beef) at commit 071610ce, the toolchain the engine pins
(`EngineVersion.Beef`). Every program Beef builds links its runtime and corlib, so the player,
the editor and the tools carry these notices; the toolchain the releases ship carries both files
at its root.
